score_interpretation: empirical healthy-reference anomaly severity [0,1], not failure probability
healthy_reference_assumption: first 30 cycles of each training engine
threshold_grid: 19 fixed caution points from 0.05 to 0.95; 60 validation-score quantiles from 0.05 to 0.995; plus 1.000001 no-alert sentinel; critical threshold midpoint(caution,1.0)
